summary: Creatine kinase leaks from damaged muscle. Most raised results come from ordinary exercise rather than disease, so what was happening in the days before the sample matters as much as the number.
what_it_measures: The activity of creatine kinase in blood, reported in U/L.

interpretations.meaning: A raised CK indicates muscle breakdown. Strenuous exercise in the preceding days is the commonest cause by a wide margin; very high values with dark urine suggest rhabdomyolysis.

when_to_seek_help: Severe muscle pain with dark or cola-coloured urine needs urgent assessment, as it can cause kidney injury.
approved_by: Demo dataset (illustrative values, not for clinical use)
